meta.titleEn: Alfacalcidol 0.5 mcg Soft Capsules (Active Vitamin D Medicine)
meta.actionKo: 체내에서 활성형 비타민 D로 전환되어 칼슘 대사를 조절하고 비타민 D 대사이상 증상과 골다공증을 개선하는 약입니다.
meta.actionEn: A medicine converted in the body to active vitamin D that regulates calcium metabolism, improving symptoms of vitamin D metabolism abnormalities and osteoporosis.

en.19f694cb: This medicine is used to improve symptoms accompanying vitamin D metabolism abnormalities (hypocalcemia, tetany, bone pain, bone lesions (changes), etc.) in chronic kidney failure, hypoparathyroidism, and vitamin D-resistant rickets and osteomalacia, and for osteoporosis.
en.d324fc57: This medicine is used to improve symptoms accompanying vitamin D metabolism abnormalities (hypocalcemia, tetany, bone pain, bone lesions (changes), etc.) in the diseases of chronic kidney failure, hypoparathyroidism, and vitamin D-resistant rickets and osteomalacia, and for osteoporosis.
en.ec19fae6: This medicine is used to improve symptoms accompanying vitamin D metabolism abnormalities (hypocalcemia, tetany, bone pain, bone changes, etc.) in chronic kidney failure, hypoparathyroidism, and vitamin D-resistant rickets and osteomalacia, and for osteoporosis.
en.2e39136a: Adults take 1 to 2 capsules (0.5 to 1 mcg) 1 time a day for chronic kidney failure and osteoporosis, and 2 to 8 capsules (1 to 4 mcg) 1 time a day for hypoparathyroidism and other diseases caused by vitamin D metabolism abnormalities.
en.4196b124: Adults take 1 to 2 capsules (0.5 to 1 mcg) per dose for chronic kidney failure and osteoporosis, and 1 to 4 mcg per dose for hypoparathyroidism and other diseases caused by vitamin D metabolism abnormalities, 1 time a day.
en.ed7c6f2f: Adults take 1 to 2 capsules (0.5 to 1 mcg) per dose, 1 time a day, by mouth for chronic kidney failure and osteoporosis, and 2 to 8 capsules (1 to 4 mcg) per dose, 1 time a day, by mouth for hypoparathyroidism and other diseases caused by vitamin D metabolism abnormalities.
en.18ffa4bd: Children take 0.01 to 0.03 mcg per kg of body weight 1 time a day for osteoporosis, and 0.05 to 0.1 mcg per kg of body weight 1 time a day for other diseases.
en.747f4b20: Children take 0.01 to 0.03 mcg per kg of body weight per dose, 1 time a day, by mouth for osteoporosis. For other diseases, they take 0.05 to 0.1 mcg per kg of body weight per dose, 1 time a day, by mouth.
en.8fd2cfc3: Children take 0.01 to 0.03 mcg per kg of body weight per dose for osteoporosis, and 0.05 to 0.1 mcg per kg of body weight per dose for other diseases, 1 time a day.
en.f0daa71c: Adjust the dose under sufficient monitoring of the patient's serum calcium levels.
en.48b44506: Do not take this medicine if you have hypercalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypermagnesemia, a Ca×P product > 3.7 (mmol/L)2, or alkalemia with blood pH > 7.44 (milk-alkali syndrome, Burnett's syndrome), if you have signs of vitamin D toxicity, or if you are hypersensitive to this medicine (vitamin D or its derivatives and analogues) or any ingredient contained in it.
en.7ad119ac: Do not take this medicine if you have hypercalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypermagnesemia, a Ca×P product > 3.7 (mmol/L)2, or alkalemia with blood pH > 7.44 (milk-alkali syndrome, Burnett's syndrome), if you have signs of vitamin D toxicity, or if you are hypersensitive to this medicine.
en.d42ab40f: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have hypercalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypermagnesemia, or a Ca×P product > 3.7 (mmol/L)2, or alkalemia with blood pH > 7.44 (milk-alkali syndrome, Burnett's syndrome), or if you have signs of vitamin D toxicity.
en.03e756a4: Do not take this medicine together with magnesium-containing preparations, vitamin D and its derivatives, calcium-containing preparations, or thiazide diuretics.
en.09c80c62: Do not take this medicine together with magnesium-containing preparations, vitamin D and its derivatives, calcium-containing preparations, or thiazide diuretics.
en.fe360f34: While taking this medicine, do not take magnesium-containing preparations, vitamin D and its derivatives, calcium-containing preparations, or thiazide diuretics.
en.13e40f9c: Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking digitalis; resins such as cholestyramine or mineral oil laxatives; phenytoin and glucocorticoids, colestipol, sucralfate, or antacids containing large amounts of aluminum; estrogens (ethinylestradiol, norethisterone); or barbiturates or antiepileptic medicines.
en.19e29e2a: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking digitalis; resins such as cholestyramine or mineral oil laxatives; phenytoin and glucocorticoids, colestipol, sucralfate, or antacids containing large amounts of aluminum; estrogens (ethinylestradiol, norethisterone); or barbiturates or antiepileptic medicines.

en.1fe3176c: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are breastfeeding; are pregnant or may be pregnant; are a child or elderly; have had kidney stones; have sarcoidosis; or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 (Sunset Yellow FCF) or have experienced allergic reactions to it.
en.4162a282: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; are a child or elderly; have had kidney stones; have sarcoidosis; or are or have been hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 (Sunset Yellow FCF).
en.729266a8: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; are a child or elderly; have had kidney stones; have sarcoidosis; or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 203 (Quinoline Yellow WS) or have experienced allergic reactions to it.
en.a5501ace: If a breastfeeding woman must take this medicine, do not breastfeed.
en.adf9fd7b: Follow the instructions on calcium intake from your diet or from supplements.
en.fb9ac4a1: For other details, check the detailed approved product information.
